headerDisplay: Configure TTLock account settings, polling, and optional IKEA DIRIGERA external doors from the custom setup UI.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID for TTLock Cloud API.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client Secret for TTLock Cloud API.

totalApiCallsPerMonth.title: Monthly API Calls
totalApiCallsPerMonth.description: Total number of TTLock API calls allowed per month. Used to automatically adjust lock polling.

pollingInterval.title: Lock Polling Interval (Seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check TTLock device status in the background.

discoveryPollingInterval.title: Discovery Polling Interval (Hours)
discoveryPollingInterval.description: How often to discover new TTLock devices in the background.

offlineInterval.title: Offline Device Removal Interval (Days)
offlineInterval.description: How long an undiscovered TTLock device is kept before removing its cached accessory.

waitTimeUpdate.title: Wait Time Update (Milliseconds)
waitTimeUpdate.description: The time to wait to combine similar commands for a device before sending a command.

externalDoors.title: External Doors
externalDoors.description: Optional IKEA DIRIGERA integration for manual doors exposed in HomeKit.

doorPollingInterval.title: Door Polling Interval (Seconds)
doorPollingInterval.description: How often to locally poll configured DIRIGERA door sensors as a fallback to events.

ip.title: DIRIGERA Hub IP
ip.description: IP address of the DIRIGERA hub.

accessToken.title: DIRIGERA Access Token
accessToken.description: Access token for the DIRIGERA hub. This is generated by pairing the hub from the custom setup UI.

name.title: Door Name
name.description: Name shown for the manual door in HomeKit. This name is also used to generate the accessory ID.

sensor.title: Linked DIRIGERA Sensor
sensor.description: DIRIGERA open/close sensor ID that reports this door state.

lock.title: Linked TTLock Lock ID
lock.description: Required TTLock device_id/lockId protected by this door.

layout.title: External Doors
layout.description: Optionally use IKEA DIRIGERA contact sensors to create external doors for additional Apple Home automation support.
